latHint: Think a free upgrade, or an extra scoop of ice cream.
pivHint: GRAVY is the savory sauce poured over turkey and potatoes. In slang, it is also an unexpected extra, like a ______ added to your paycheck.
winText: Pure extra. GRAVY was the pivot - a sauce for the turkey to a welcome BONUS.
lossText: BONUS - an extra reward beyond what you expected. GRAVY was the pivot: GRAVY tops a turkey dinner, and in slang GRAVY means a pleasant extra, a BONUS on top of what you earned.
